text: Files landing in a folder need their own tracking — Autoloader.
Last lesson's watermark tracked new rows. Autoloader tracks new files landing in a folder continuously — without re-scanning the entire folder every time just to figure out what's already been seen.

Spark dot read stream, with format cloud files, is Autoloader's entry point. The checkpoint location tracks exactly which files it's already processed — so rerunning this exact code only picks up genuinely new files, automatically. No manual watermark column at all.

And Autoloader infers a schema from arriving files once, and caches it — a real, practical answer to Foundations' infer schema cost concern, combined with this course's own schema evolution, both at once.
This is bronze ingestion's real production replacement for a one-time manual read. Next lesson: structured streaming basics, the engine underneath Autoloader itself.
